pathCoordinateContract.rootNormalization: Only the owned fixture root may be represented symbolically; retain all actual resolved-prefix codepoints and all fixed suffix points.
pathCoordinateContract.resolvedRoot: Resolve the valid owned root independently before the observed operation, using actual pathlib; do not resolve the invalid parent or consume its error to construct expectations.
pathCoordinateContract.unicodeObject: resolvedRootPoints followed by separator codepoint47 followed by fixed componentPoints; complete actual error object must equal this sequence.
pathCoordinateContract.start: length(resolvedRootPoints)+1+index of first invalid surrogate in fixed componentPoints
pathCoordinateContract.message: Exact ASCII utf-8 UnicodeEncodeError message with decimal start and end-1 inserted; no alternate wording accepted.
pathCoordinateContract.restriction: No arbitrary error-path normalization, basename stripping, slash collapsing or surrogate normalization.

metadataContract.encoding: All inode/device/size/time-nanosecond integers losslessly represented as decimal strings; modes exact integers.
metadataContract.sentinel: Exact kind/mode/inode/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs/content unchanged; atime recorded separately and unconstrained.
metadataContract.nativeNumbers: Actual observed values only, never fixture constants. Assertions use explicit equality relationships.
metadataContract.temporary: Complete post-close stat retained before replace/unlink; where replace occurs, target inode equals post-close temp inode, exact installed bytes/mode. Rename/chmod ctime may change and is recorded, not forced equal.
metadataContract.parent: Exact directory kind/mode0700; inode stable. Creation/removal may update mtime/ctime; retain actual values without invented inequality.
